info.name: Ashby API Key Interview Event API
info.description:
Complete public API for accessing resources in your Ashby instance. Includes applications, candidates, jobs, interviews, offers, surveys, custom fields, organization metadata, files, reports, approvals, and webhooks.

Contact Support:
 Name: Ashby Support

request.description:
Lists interview events associated with an interview schedule

See the [Pagination and Incremental Synchronization](/docs/pagination-and-incremental-sync) guide for detailed usage examples.

**Requires the [`interviewsRead`](authentication#permissions-intervieweventlist) permission.**
